Method: ordinary least-squares linear regression on the indexed series (x=0..n-1, y=values), respects null gaps by preserving original index as x (so `[10,null,14,null,18]` slope-2 forecasts at series.length=5 → 20). Live manifestation of the sub-1 first-hover-flash 🔄 plus a second symptom (pile-up). **Root cause:** sub-1's `defaultOpen={true}` on lazy-mounted `<Tooltip>` initialized each cell's Radix state to `instant-open`; subsequent pointerleave didn't transition the forced-open state to closed, so each freshly-mounted cell during a sweep stayed visible. **Fix shipped:** dropped lazy-mount + `defaultOpen` entirely.
